All 120 S5 relabelings and complement are verified at integer chain level. The standalone checker reconstructs all data.

value.rationale: This is a complete natural top-degree integral homology lattice under a canonical 240-element group, exhibited through geometric octahedral cycles and primitive dual cochains. It refines the known rank and rational character and determines modular order-five Jordan structure, neither recoverable from those prior weaker results. The exact invariant is motivated by the graph symmetry and incidence construction.
